en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ali Bin Al Hakam, from Suleyman Bin Amro Al Nakhaie who said, 
‘I heard Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> saying:
‘Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> said: ‘Arise early with the charity, for the affliction would not bypass it’.
en.sarwar: 5. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Ali ibn al-Hakam from Sulayman ibn ‘Amr al-Nakha‘iy who has said the following: “I heard abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, say, ‘
The Messenger of Allah has said, ‘Do not be late in giving charity; misfortunes cannot bypass it (charity).”’
